description: Find, download, read, and summarize research papers related to the work in the current directory. Searches arXiv, OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar, and Google Scholar, with a hierarchical mode (hubs, surveys, citation snowball). Maintains a CSL-YAML reference database (references.yaml) compatible with pandoc's --bibliography flag, so the same file serves both the skill and document builds. Triggers: update references, refresh the bibliography, find papers, related work, literature review, what's been published on, recent papers, cite sources for, background reading, summarize this paper, search scholar.
